page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.s3 server family. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores, operating with a single thread per core. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It runs on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It features no integrated GPU hardware and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the hardware profile aligns with compute-focused workloads that do not require large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource sharing. This makes the instance suitable for lightweight compute-optimized tasks, basic web serving, and distributed microservices.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.s3 family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core, providing consistent processing capabilities without hyper-threading. The system is configured with 8.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external network-attached storage for data persistence. Lacking public IPv4 addresses out of the box, it is designed for secure internal deployments. The dedicated resource allocation and compute-leaning hardware profile make it suitable for lightweight compute-intensive workloads, microservices, and dedicated application hosting.
